integrity: The proof is analytic and uses the published equality classification plus an exact block-level norm formula. The packaged finite enumeration is only a stress test through ambient dimension \(16\), not evidence for the general theorem.
scientific limitations: The theorem applies only to configurations attaining the sharp value \(2n-d\) for the squared longest signed sum. It gives exact, not noise-stable, reconstruction from the complete signed-sum multiset and makes no claim for the unresolved nonsharp regime.
title: Signed-sum spectra reconstruct every sharp orthogonal-simplex decomposition
